name: Alfentanil
summary: Alfentanil, sold under the brand name Alfenta among others, is a potent, short-acting synthetic opioid analgesic drug used for anesthesia in surgery. It is an analogue of fentanyl with around one-fourth to one-tenth the potency, one-third the duration of action, and an onset of action four times faster than that of fentanyl.

pharmacology.text: Alfentanil has moderate binding affinity for the μ-opioid receptor in humans at 7.391 nM (Morphine 1.168).

uses.text: Alfentanil, sold under the brand name Alfenta among others, is a potent, short-acting synthetic opioid analgesic drug used for anesthesia in surgery.

zhOther: 阿芬太尼, 阿华吩坦尼

sideEffects.en: Like other strong opioids, it can slow or stop breathing, stiffen the chest muscles, slow the heart and lower blood pressure, and cause nausea and drowsiness. Overdose can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他強效鴉片類一樣，它可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止、使胸部肌肉僵硬、心跳變慢、血壓下降，並引起噁心與嗜睡。過量可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他强效鸦片类一样，它可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止、使胸部肌肉僵硬、心跳变慢、血压下降，并引起恶心与嗜睡。过量可能致命。

fact.en: Alfentanil was developed at Janssen Pharmaceutica in Belgium in the 1970s, the same company where Paul Janssen had created fentanyl.
fact.zh: 阿華吩坦尼於 1970 年代在比利時的楊森藥廠開發，Paul Janssen 正是在這家公司創造了芬太尼。
fact.zhHans: 阿华吩坦尼于 1970 年代在比利时的杨森药厂开发，Paul Janssen 正是在这家公司创造了芬太尼。
